To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Pha Din is a good location for studying the impact of biomass burning on aerosol optical properties, (2) the meteorological conditions are favorable for the transport of air masses with high aerosol loadings during the biomass burning season, and (3) the aerosol optical parameters at Pha Din show similar annual variations as the aerosol optical thickness measured at the nearby AOD station Son La.

the annual variations in aerosol optical properties at Pha Din (Vietnam) are dominated by high biomass burning activity during February–May, which leads to a significant increase of the aerosol loadings and a decrease of the aerosol optical characteristics.
